title: Speak first when there is no card and campaigns are held

history.content: Nothing is wrong so far: all 124 emails sent were delivered, none bounced, and nobody has replied yet. That's normal this early, since most went out in the last two days.
Open my Wide Email campaign page
Your campaign page is open on the right. It shows the 124 emails delivered and the 57 prospects still waiting for a first email.

message: (Not written by the user. The dashboard asked you to speak first: the user has the Copilot open and seems stuck or looking for something. Read `currentPage` and `recentActions` in the context, and the conversation so far, to guess what they are trying to do. Answer that in one or two short sentences, then call present_choices with 2 or 3 options that move them forward: open the right page, start the action, or answer what they look for. Never pushy, never a sales pitch, no greeting, and do not say you noticed their clicks.)

facts: Their dashboard shows the banner "Campaigns paused: no payment method" on every page: they removed their card, so billing stopped both campaigns (Wide Email and Reply Booking). Nothing is running.
The account is postpaid; the balance due is $21.40. Their Billing page shows "Add a card so your campaigns can run on credit."
Once a card is added (the balance due is charged to it), a person starts the campaigns again: nothing resumes on its own.
The dashboard's Spent is $103.16 since they started. Their campaigns reached 828 people and brought one interested reply.
expect: Says the campaigns are paused because no card is on the account, and ends on adding a card on Billing then starting the campaigns again.
